user.title: Set up Ordnungs-Tracker
user.description: The Ordnungs-Tracker keeps track of what is stored where. No input is required. Your data lives in the file `ordnungstracker/inventar.json` in the configuration directory.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Ordnungs-Tracker is already set up. Only one instance is possible.

init.title: Ordnungs-Tracker settings
init.description: Reminder thresholds (e.g. "lent items are overdue after 30 days") are set in the app; they are part of your data.

data.todo_auto: Add restock items to the to-do list automatically
data.admin_only: Deleting and settings for administrators only
data.show_sidebar: Show the "Ordnung" entry in the sidebar

data_description.todo_entity: The service "Transfer restocking to to-do list" adds items below their minimum stock here.
data_description.todo_auto: As soon as something falls below its minimum it is added to the chosen list (without duplicates).
data_description.admin_only: Applies to the interface and the actions. Automations without a user are not affected.
data_description.show_sidebar: Applies once the user interface is installed.

search.name: Search
search.description: Searches the inventory and returns hits with their full path.

query.name: Search term
query.description: All words must match; input like 14 or #14 jumps to the box with that number.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Only entries of this kind (kind id, e.g. kiste).

within.name: Within
within.description: Only entries inside this room, shelf or box (id or number).

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Person id; the effective (possibly inherited) owner counts.

checked_out.name: Checked out
checked_out.description: Only checked-out (or only not checked-out) entries.

include_archived.name: Include archived
include_archived.description: Also show disposed or given-away entries.

get_node.name: Read entry
get_node.description: Returns all details of an entry including path and contents.

create_node.name: Create entry
create_node.description: Creates a new entry. Only the name is required.

parent.name: Location
parent.description: Id or number of the parent; top level if omitted.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Kind id; a suitable one is suggested if omitted.

number.name: Number
number.description: A number, or auto for the lowest free number.

min_quantity.name: Minimum stock
min_quantity.description: Below this the entry shows up under "Restock".

update_node.name: Change entry
update_node.description: Changes details of an entry; unspecified details stay as they are.

move_node.name: Move entry
move_node.description: Moves entries including their contents to a new location.

target.name: Target
target.description: Id or number of the new location.

delete_node.name: Delete entry
delete_node.description: Moves the entry to the trash (restorable for 30 days).

mode.name: Delete mode
mode.description: Trash with contents, or remove only the entry and lift its contents one level up.

check_out.name: Check out
check_out.description: Records that something is lent out or temporarily elsewhere. Its home is kept.

type.name: Type
type.description: Lent, or taken out / stored elsewhere.

to.name: To whom / where
to.description: e.g. neighbour Huber or at the tyre shop.

no_reminder.name: Long-term loan
no_reminder.description: No "not returned for long" reminder for this loan.

return_node.name: Put back
return_node.description: Ends the checkout; the entry is back in its place.

adjust_quantity.name: Change quantity
adjust_quantity.description: Changes the quantity by a value or sets it (never below 0).

transfer_to_todo.name: Transfer restocking to to-do list
transfer_to_todo.description: Adds everything below its minimum stock to a to-do list (without duplicates).

todo_entity.name: To-do list
todo_entity.description: The list chosen in the options if omitted.

load_sample.name: Load sample data
load_sample.description: Loads a small sample household (about 60 entries) to try things out – only into an empty inventory.

remove_sample.name: Remove sample data
remove_sample.description: Removes the sample data again. Your own entries inside it move to "Unsorted".

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Re-reads inventar.json, e.g. after editing it by hand.

create_backup.name: Create backup
create_backup.description: Immediately creates a backup copy of inventar.json.

export.name: Export
export.description: Returns the inventory as a JSON file or a readable Markdown list.

node.name: Subtree
node.description: Only this entry with its contents (Markdown only).

options.lift: only the entry, contents one level up

invalid_file.title: The inventory file is invalid
invalid_file.description:
Ordnungs-Tracker has **changed nothing** and will only start again once the file is fine.

File: `{path}`

{problems}

**What to do?** Fix the listed places with a file editor; Ordnungs-Tracker retries automatically. Alternatively copy the last valid backup from the `sicherungen` folder over `inventar.json`: `{backup}`.

newer_schema.title: The inventory file is from a newer version

external_invalid.title: inventar.json was edited by hand and is now invalid
external_invalid.description:
Until the file is valid again, **no changes are saved**.

File: `{path}`

{problems}

Unsaved changes of your own are in: `{conflict}`.

**What to do?** Fix the file; it is re-read automatically.

conflict.title: inventar.json changed while there were unsaved changes
conflict.description: The outside change was adopted. Your unsaved state is next to the file as `{conflict}` (`{path}`). Check whether anything is missing and copy it over by hand if needed.

save_failed.title: The inventory could not be saved

not_loaded.message: Ordnungs-Tracker is not loaded. Check Settings → Repairs for a complaint about inventar.json.

no_todo_entity.message: No to-do list is selected. Choose one in the integration options or pass todo_entity.

todo_unknown.message: The to-do list {entity_id} does not exist.

admin_required.message: Administrator rights are required. The integration options restrict deleting and settings to administrators.
